Optimal.Notes: High settings at native resolution deliver the intended atmospheric visuals with a stable 60 fps. A 7 W TDP is more than sufficient for this engine and gives solid battery life.

profiles.Summary: Inscryption is a lightweight indie card game that runs excellently on the Steam Deck, well within the hardware's capabilities given its modest PC requirements. The game's 2D-heavy presentation and low GPU demands mean it can hit 60 fps with minimal power draw across all profiles.
profiles.BasisNote: No Deck-specific player reports were available; profiles are estimated from the game's very modest PC requirements (GTX 550 Ti minimum) and the Deck's RDNA 2 GPU. On first run, verify the game launches correctly under Default Proton and check that the atmospheric post-processing effects (film grain, colour grading) are present — if any visual glitches appear, try Proton Experimental.

MaxBattery.Notes: At 4 W TDP and a 400 MHz GPU clock this lightweight card game holds a rock-solid 30 fps with excellent battery life. The 40 Hz refresh rate pairs cleanly with the 30 fps cap for smooth pacing.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Uncapped GPU clock with maximum settings; the game is so undemanding that the Deck will throttle itself down naturally. There is no meaningful visual difference from Optimal, but this profile removes any artificial constraints.

Optimal.Notes: At 60 fps the card animations and atmospheric lighting feel smooth and polished; 6 W TDP is ample for this engine and keeps the fan nearly silent throughout.

profiles.Summary: Inscryption is a lightweight indie card game with minimal 3D rendering demands, running well within the Steam Deck's capabilities and achieving a stable 60 fps with very low power draw. The game is rated Playable (not Verified) primarily due to minor UI/controller quirks, but ProtonDB reporters at platinum tier confirm it runs smoothly under Proton.
profiles.BasisNote: No specific Steam Deck player reports were available; profiles are estimated from the PC minimum/recommended requirements (GTX 550 Ti minimum, GTX 1050 recommended) and the game's known lightweight indie card-game nature. On first run, verify the game reaches 60 fps comfortably at medium settings — if it does, the Max Performance 90 Hz profile should also hold without issue.

MaxBattery.Notes: Inscryption is extremely light on GPU; a 4 W TDP and low GPU clock are more than sufficient. This profile maximises session length for long card-game runs away from a charger.

KnownIssues: Steam Deck Verified status is only 'Playable', suggesting some UI or input elements may not be fully optimized for controller/gamepad navigation.
Some mouse-and-keyboard UI elements may appear during certain puzzle sequences that require workarounds on a controller.
No native Linux build; runs via Proton, though platinum ProtonDB reports indicate no significant compatibility issues.

MaxPerformance.Notes: The game's modest engine easily saturates 90 Hz on the OLED panel at full quality; uncapping the frame rate and letting the GPU run freely has negligible visual benefit beyond 90 fps, so the 90 Hz refresh rate is the natural ceiling here.
